title: PNG zTXt stores keywords and compressed text separately
summary: The zTXt data is keywords, zero-separated, compression method bytes, and compressed text. The text portion of method 0 is a zlib stream.
detail: Keywords are not compressed. Determine zero separation and method before decompressing subsequent data; text is interpreted as Latin-1.
boundary: iTXt is another structure that also contains language tags, translation keywords, and UTF-8 text; the same set of offsets cannot be reused.
relevance: When viewing attachment metadata, avoid handing keywords and method bytes to the decompressor.
